authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10187.11 *mōṭṭa explicitly gives Old Marwari moṭaü big/fat and Gujarati moṭũ; the adjective is used in the source elder-sibling expression. The specific o-vowel subsection is selected, not the general *muṭṭa head or *mōṭṭha subsection. CDIAL 9349 gives Hindi bahan, Gujarati bahen/ben and regional baiṇ sister. Two ordered component edges preserve big/elder + sister, retaining source feminine moṭī/moṭi and vowel/nasal notation. The English elder label belongs to the full phrase, not the sister root alone; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: moṭi ben.
